integrity: Analytical proof of all-size optimizer and scaling, alongside an executable finite checker. Computational tests are corroborative only. Publication priority and independent validation have not been certified.
limitations: Simple wheel with positive prices constant within spoke and rim classes; objective is total pairwise electrical resistance, not robust, worst-pair or spectral-gap optimization. Non-priced wheel spectral reductions are previously published. A close weighted-wheel paper was identified but its full text was not inspected, leaving possible specialized overlap.
title: The sharp rim-deletion price frontier and critical window in wheel resistance design
